trigger.note: Sequential trigger frozen on development data only (cs_dev, cs_fresh2, cs_fresh; offline comparison in evaluation/seq_dev.py and docs/patent_evaluation/PREREG_DECK_PROTOCOL.md). Daily summary = mean of the middle half of the 24 hourly residuals against the trusted snapshot; standardised with the calibration days' mean and sd (sd floor 0.05, clip +/-3); statistic = sqrt(n)*|mean of the last n<=14 standardised days|; trips when it exceeds the global constant c. k is unused by the window statistic.
